properties.name: DB_URL
properties.description: PostgreSQL JDBC URL. Mapped to spring.datasource.url via application.properties.

properties.name: DB_USERNAME
properties.description: PostgreSQL username. Mapped to spring.datasource.username via application.properties.

properties.name: DB_PASSWORD
properties.description: PostgreSQL password. Required — mapped to spring.datasource.password via application.properties.

properties.name: firebase.mock
properties.description: When set to true, the Firebase Admin SDK is NOT initialised and the security filter runs in mock mode — every request is treated as an authenticated user with uid 'mock-user'. Useful for local development without a real Firebase project. Must be false in production.

properties.name: firebase.config.path
properties.description: Location of the Firebase service-account JSON file used to initialise the Firebase Admin SDK. Accepts Spring resource path notation: 'classpath:firebase-service-account.json' for a file on the classpath, or 'file:/absolute/path/to/service-account.json' for an external file. This property is ignored when firebase.mock=true.
